newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Rostelekom shares rise 11.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Rostelekom shares rise 11.6 pct.

text.p: Shares in Russian telecommunications company Rostelekom rose 11.6 percent to $3.38, a record, by 1040 GMT on Thursday from Wednesday's close of $3.03.
Operators said the company, one of Russia's leading shares, had been undervalued in the market's new year bull run.

Investors had been encouraged by a Rostelekom statement that it would not be affected by the transfer of its government-owned controlling shares packet to Svyazinvest domestic telecoms holding company, they added.
